parameters.help_en: The name of the live streaming application. The name can be up to 256 characters long and can contain digits, uppercase and lowercase letters, hyphens (-), and underscores (_). The AppName must match the AppName in the ingest URL for the template to take effect
parameters.help_zh: 直播流应用名称。不超过256字符，支持数字、大小写字母、短划线（-）、下划线（_）AppName名称与推流地址中的AppName名称对应，模板才能生效
parameters.name: app

parameters.help_en: The name of the subtitle template
parameters.name: subtitle_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the virtual background template
parameters.name: studio_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the rule is triggered by stream pulling. Valid values:

true: Subtitles are generated when stream pulling starts. If no stream is pulled for 5 minutes, subtitle generation stops. Subtitle generation resumes when stream pulling starts again.

false: Subtitles are generated when stream ingest starts, regardless of whether a stream is being pulled
parameters.help_zh:
拉流触发。取值：
true：拉流时启动字幕，若5分钟内没有拉流则会断掉字幕，后续再有拉流才会启动。
false：只要有推流就启动字幕，与是否有拉流无关
parameters.name: is_lazy

parameters.help_en:
The specifications of the output subtitles. Valid values:

Landscape low definition 360p (640 × 360): `lp_ld`

Portrait low definition 360p (360 × 640): `lp_ld_v`

Landscape standard definition 480p (854 × 480): `lp_sd`

Portrait standard definition 480p (480 × 854): `lp_sd_v`

Landscape high definition 720p (1280 × 720): `lp_hd`

Portrait high definition 720p (720 × 1280): `lp_hd_v`

Landscape ultra high definition 1080p (1920 × 1080): `lp_ud`

Portrait ultra high definition 1080p (1080 × 1920): `lp_ud_v`
parameters.help_zh:
字幕输出规格，取值：
横屏流畅 360P 640x360：`lp_ld`
竖屏流畅 360P 360x640：`lp_ld_v`
横屏标清 480P 854x480：`lp_sd`
竖屏标清 480P 480x854：`lp_sd_v`
横屏高清 720P 1280x720：`lp_hd`
竖屏高清 720P 720x1280：`lp_hd_v`
横屏超清 1080P 1920x1080：`lp_ud`
竖屏超清 1080P 1080x1920：`lp_ud_v`
parameters.name: live_template

parameters.help_en: The description of the subtitle rule. The description can contain Chinese and English characters, digits, and special characters. It can be up to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 字幕规则描述。可包含中英文、数字、字符，不超过128位
parameters.name: description
